**Viral AI‑Tools on TikTok (last 7 days)**  

| # | Tool | 1‑sentence description | Link |
|---|------|------------------------|------|
| 1 | **Viggle** – AI‑driven video‑generator that turns a photo or short clip into a ready‑to‑post TikTok clip. | Users upload a picture, type a prompt (e.g., “dance”) and Viggle animates the subject, a trend that hit #Viggle and #ViggleAI on TikTok. | https://newrank.cn/article/detail/27539【8†L58-L59】 |
| 2 | **Pika Art AI** – surreal image‑manipulation app that lets creators “crush, squish, inflate, cake” their photos. | The app’s viral effect chain is a hit on TikTok, with creators posting before‑and‑after shots that go viral. | https://www.the-sun.com/tech/12669278/pika-art-ai-app-viral-tiktok-crush-squish-cake-photo/【3†L15-L20】 |
| 3 | **Argil** – deep‑fake AI TikTok video generator that clones users’ faces onto new scenes. | Argil lets creators produce high‑quality 9:16 videos from a script and a clone, sparking a new trend of “no‑camera” content. | https://www.argil.ai/blog/argil-the-first-deepfake-ai-tiktok-video-generator-platform【1†L1-L4】 |
| 4 | **Symphony Digital Avatars** (TikTok Symphony) – AI‑powered avatar creation and dubbing suite. | Brands and creators can build custom avatars and auto‑dub videos into 10+ languages, fueling a wave of AI‑enhanced brand content. | https://newsroom.tiktok.com/en-us/announcing-symphony-avatars/【10†L10-L13】 |

**Free AI tools, skills & MCP‑servers (last 7 days)**  

| # | Tool/Server | 1‑sentence description | Link |
|---|-------------|------------------------|------|
| 5 | **Hiya Deepfake Voice Detector** – Chrome extension that detects voice cloning in audio/video. | It scans a second of audio/video and flags whether the voice is real or AI‑generated, free for everyone. | https://hiya.com/products/deepfake-voice-detector【5†L12-L15】 |
| 6 | **OpenAI Playground Prompt‑Writing Feature** – hidden tool that auto‑generates prompts for other prompts. | The free feature streamlines prompt engineering, letting users produce multi‑platform content with a single input. | https://www.geeky-gadgets.com/secret-playground-prompt-writing-feature/【12†L6-L13】 |
| 7 | **Mochi‑1 (Genmo)** – open‑source text‑to‑video model released under Apache‑2.0. | Mochi‑1 offers 480 p video generation with strong motion and prompt‑adherence, usable for free on Genmo’s site. | https://www.tomsguide.com/ai/meet-mochi-1-the-latest-free-and-open-source-ai-video-model【13†L9-L14】 |
| 8 | **Playwright MCP Server** – a free Model‑Context‑Protocol server that lets agents automate a real Chrome browser. | It runs locally with no sign‑in and is the go‑to MCP server for browser‑automation tasks. | https://mcp.so/collections/free-mcp-servers【7†L4-L8】 |

*All information is current as of 27 Nov 2024.*
